# {{ site.name }}

> {{ site.name }} is a plain-English AI safety blog and newsletter for ordinary readers. It rates major AI developments on a 0 to 10 scale ("from 0 to 'start digging'") and explains what changed, why it matters, and what you can probably ignore. Ratings are a temperature check on the evidence, not a probability of catastrophe, and they can change when the evidence changes.

Key facts:
- Name: {{ site.name }}
- Tagline: {{ site.tagline }}
- Topics: AI safety and risk, including autonomy, cybersecurity, biological risk, military use, real-world AI harm, frontier-lab safety practices, and regulation
- For: non-experts who want AI risk without the panic
- Method: trace claims to primary sources, label uncertainty, correct in public, keep the temperature honest
- AI use: AI helps with research and drafting; a human is responsible for what is published
- Contact: {{ site.email }}
- Feed: {{ site.url }}/rss.xml
- Newsletter: [Subscribe on beehiiv]({{ site.beehiiv.subscribe_url }})
